gloss: thorough enjoyment; relishing to the full

definitions.gloss: thorough enjoyment; relishing to the full
definitions.explanation: The act of enjoying something fully and to one's complete satisfaction, savoring every aspect of an experience.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}を{満喫|まんきつ}した。
examples.english: I thoroughly enjoyed my day off.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}を{満喫|まんきつ}してリフレッシュした。
examples.english: I refreshed myself by fully enjoying the hot springs.

examples.japanese: {旅行先|りょこうさき}で{地元|じもと}の{料理|りょうり}を{満喫|まんきつ}することができた。
examples.english: I was able to relish the local cuisine at my travel destination.

notes:
A する noun meaning to enjoy something to the fullest extent. Composed of {満|まん} (full) and {喫|きつ} (to receive, to consume). Conveys deep, complete satisfaction rather than casual enjoyment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休日|きゅうじつ}を{満喫|まんきつ}する — to fully enjoy a holiday
- {自然|しぜん}を{満喫|まんきつ}する — to savor nature
- {旅|たび}を{満喫|まんきつ}する — to relish a trip
- {人生|じんせい}を{満喫|まんきつ}する — to enjoy life to the fullest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {楽|たの}しむ — to enjoy; more general and everyday, while {満喫|まんきつ} emphasizes completeness and deep satisfaction
- {堪能|たんのう} — to enjoy fully; very close in meaning but {堪能|たんのう} also means "proficient" and has a slightly more literary feel
